<!-- pr-reviewer: a9c44916a40043a02b7e60aacd8c441a3d9d9384 -->
This is a full independent review of head `a9c44916a`. The reviewer did not write this change.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good
- The repeat is the same `Pass { tip, shift }` pushed twice (`infeed.rs`, `passes`). Tip depth, lattice shift and helix phase are the same, so a repeat cannot cut deeper or move. The finishing pass and the spring passes at the root are not repeated.
- Alternating infeed counts depths, not cuts, so a repeat keeps its flank.
- The verdict and the post see the same laid moves. The motion test compares the move spans of each repeat with its first cut, for all 3 methods and both schedules, and the verdict stays silent.
- Every dialect that can write threading was checked. Only `fanuc-lathe.cps` and `tormach-lathe.cps` define `onThreadCycle` and write G76. Both now refuse the record by name through `g76Why` (`fanuc-lathe.cps:830`, `tormach-lathe.cps:751`). The G32 / G33 chains post the repeated passes as plain moves. `grblhal.cps` and `tormach-plasma.cps` write no thread cycle. No third dialect was missed.
- The Tormach refusal matches the public LinuxCNC G76 documentation. One G76 block has one `P` / `I` / `J` / `K` / `R` / `Q` / `H` word set and cuts each depth once. It has no word for a repeated depth. Refusing is correct. Ignoring the flag would post passes that verify did not see.
- Defaults are byte-identical. The stamp byte is written only when the flag is set. The DTO key (`skip_serializing_if`) and the stream word `REP 1` are written only when set. Old projects and old streams read with the repeat off. No golden changed.
- The stream parser refuses an invalid `REP` value by name. `write-parse-write` is a fixed point.
- No `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` is added. Capacity uses `saturating_mul`. Spring passes stay capped by `MAX_SPRING_PASSES`.
- No snapshot PNG, no `PROCESS_VERSION`, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit. The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #418`. The decision file `docs/decisions/418-thread-repeat-pass.md` has the chosen and dropped options. The UI text is plain English. The doc table in `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md` is updated.
- No new `camcraft-*` dependency edge. All tests are added to existing suites, so the Gate maps are unchanged.

## Results (local, merged with current main)
`git merge-tree` of `origin/main` (`7c514c874`) with the head is clean. Built and run in the existing worktree with a warm debug build. The runner was not used.

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| app `lathe_post_tormach_thread` | 8 passed |
| app `lathe_post_g76` | 8 passed |
| app `lathe_post_g76_schedule` | 7 passed |
| app `thread_passes` / `lathe_post_tormach` / `lathe_post` | 7 / 8 / 5 passed |
| app `turning_thread_infeed` | 5 passed |
| app `project_roundtrip` | 73 passed |
| motion `turning_thread` / `turning_thread_cycle` / `turning_thread_infeed` | 18 / 3 / 10 passed |
| post crate, all suites | 59 binaries, 518 passed, 0 failed |
| ui lib, filter `thread` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 6 passed |
| clippy `-p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: app lib, the other app suites, the ui suites other than `thread`, the heavy lanes, the pixel snapshots (release lane).

## Requested before merge
None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. **MCP.** The infeed plan, `spring_passes` included, has no MCP tool in `crates/app/src/mcp/`. The new field follows that gap. AGENTS.md "Commands ship with an MCP tool" asks for a named `MCP:` follow-up. Please file one issue for the whole infeed plan (`P5`, `area:mcp`, `source:agent`) and name it in the PR body. No such issue exists now.
2. **Screenshots.** Before and after images exist in the PR body (both URLs return 200). They are from the author's earlier head, and the body says so. The row label is "Repeat each depth". The tooltip text is not shown in a still. This head has no new GUI check. The reviewer did not start the GUI.
3. **Structural twin.** No assertion in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs` covers the new checkbox. The ui test run here is the `thread` filter only. A structural assertion for the Passes tab row would help. This is a follow-up, not a blocker.
4. **File size.** `crates/app/src/operation/params.rs` is 1783 lines and grows by 5. It was over the limit before this PR.
5. **Parent follow-up.** The unverified Fanuc readings of the parent PR stay tracked in #1842. This PR adds no new Fanuc reading.

## Not proven without a controller run
- No G32 / G33 repeat program has run on a controller or machine. The repeat posts as the same moves that verify saw, but a real spindle-sync thread with a repeated pass is not exercised.
- No lathe simulation run of a repeated plan.
- Both G76 refusals are pinned by tests only. No control has read the refused records.
- The Windows-only and Linux-only readings were not split. The diff adds no `cfg(windows)` line.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
